sloka: तांस्तु सर्वान्विनिर्भिद्य तदस्त्रमपहत्य च ।जघ्नुस्ते राक्षसं घोरमेकं शतसहस्रशः ।। ७.२१.३७ ॥
transliteration: tāṁstu sarvānvinirbhidya tadastramapahatya ca ।jaghnuste rākṣasaṁ ghoramekaṁ śatasahasraśaḥ ।। 7.21.37 ॥

translations.english: But having pierced through all those weapons and repelled that missile, Yama's soldiers, in hundreds of thousands, struck that single terrible demon.
